meta.scope: County health department budgets, not maternal-specific spending
meta.source: Budget credibility workbook (preliminary, being verified against Controller of Budget reports)
meta.statusRule: on-track >= 80% absorption; lagging < 80%; data-incomplete if actual missing or under 20% of estimate
meta.disclaimer: AI-assisted story leads can contain mistakes. They are prompts for reporting, not findings. Verify every figure against the source documents and with officials before publishing.
meta.surveyNote: The Kenya Mini DHS 2025-26 publishes the maternal mortality ratio at national level only: 263 deaths per 100,000 live births (confidence interval 121 to 405). There is no county-level MMR. County indicators used here: facility delivery, skilled birth attendance and 4+ antenatal visits.
